info.title: VYRO API
info.description:
Backend for VYRO. Don't just scroll. Challenge yourself.

Every `/v1` endpoint takes `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>`. A signed-in user without
a profile gets `403 registration_required` and should call `POST /v1/me` first.
Endpoints that are not built yet return `501`.

get.description:
Today's streak rescue suggestion, or null when nothing needs rescuing.

Call it when the app opens. The first call of the day where a challenge is at risk lets the
coach choose one suggestion (a few seconds with AI); later calls return the same one. Works
without AI too, with rule-based suggestions.
